banner: DRAFT for human review. Not approved. Do not use with members until the safety lead and a qualified mental-health professional have signed off.

review.notes: Written as a starting seed list. Not tested on real member posts. Telugu stays blocked from going live until a Telugu reviewer has checked every line.

usage: Matches only route a post to a human moderator and show helplines. Never auto-reply as a person, never block or delete the post.

normalise: strip punctuation and emoji before matching, but keep emoji for the moderator view
treat zero-width characters and extra spaces as absent
match both native script and roman forms, plus every entry in variants
tierRules: danger: route to the on-call wellbeing moderator at once and show the helpline sheet first.
high: route to the wellbeing moderator queue and show the helpline sheet.
low: suggest a private check-in from the pod lead. Show the helpline sheet as a quiet link, not a pop-up.
A low or high match together with a farewell, a method, a time ('tonight', 'aaj raat') or giving things away counts as danger.
A falsePositives match lowers the priority of a low or high match only. It never hides a danger match. A human still sees the post.
never: auto-reply as if a human wrote it
block, hide, delete or shadow-ban the post
tell the pod that a post was flagged
show an upsell, a quote card or a celebration to the member while a flag is open
send the private Chotu chat text anywhere without the member tapping 'Talk to a person'

behaviouralSignals.signal: sudden silence after result day from someone who posted most days
behaviouralSignals.note: Pod lead check-in within 48 hours. Upgrade to high if the last post was a farewell or hopeless.

behaviouralSignals.signal: leaving the pod or deleting posts soon after a result
behaviouralSignals.note: Gentle private message. Do not ask them to justify leaving.

behaviouralSignals.signal: giving away books, notes, test-series logins or belongings with phrases like 'ab zaroorat nahi'
behaviouralSignals.note: Giving things away is a classic warning sign. Combined with a farewell it is danger.

behaviouralSignals.signal: thank-you-for-everything or farewell posts that do not fit the conversation
behaviouralSignals.note: Treat as danger if it is late at night, after a result, or with any hopeless phrase.

behaviouralSignals.signal: a run of low moods on Close the Day
behaviouralSignals.note: Private by default. Only the person the member chose hears about it.

behaviouralSignals.signal: posting at 2 to 5 a.m. several nights running with hopeless language
behaviouralSignals.note: Sleep loss plus hopelessness. Check the night roster.

hi.name: Hindi and Hinglish
hi.reviewNote: A native Hindi speaker must check every line, including the romanised forms and variants.

danger.text: मैं खुद को खत्म कर लूँगा
danger.roman: main khud ko khatam kar lunga
danger.note: Direct statement of intent. Feminine form 'kar lungi' is equally common.
Direct. Check it is not a quote or a GS discussion.
Also appears in GS topics (farmer suicides). See falsePositives. Intent wording ('kar lunga', 'karne wala hoon') is the signal.
Direct wish not to live.
Farewell. Treat as danger unless clearly about leaving the app or a group.
Farewell plus apology to family is a strong sign.

danger.text: आज रात सब खत्म कर दूँगा
danger.roman: aaj raat sab khatam kar dunga
danger.note: Time plus intent.

danger.text: नींद की गोलियाँ जमा कर ली हैं
danger.roman: neend ki goliyan jama kar li hain
danger.note: Mentions a method or means. Moderators should not ask for details beyond what safety needs.
Method mention. 'Phansi' also appears in GS discussions of capital punishment. See falsePositives.

danger.text: मेरे जाने के बाद मेरी किताबें ले लेना
danger.roman: mere jaane ke baad meri kitaben le lena
danger.note: Farewell plus giving things away.

high.note: Very common after results. Often means 'this attempt is over', sometimes means much more. Always gets a human read. 'Syllabus khatam' is a false positive.
Exhaustion or giving up. Read the thread around it.
Passive wish not to live. Upgrade to danger with any time, method or farewell.
Feeling like a burden. Strong warning sign.
Burden. Common for older repeaters supported by family.

high.text: घरवालों को मुँह नहीं दिखा सकता
high.roman: gharwalon ko munh nahi dikha sakta
high.note: Shame after a result. Check in quickly.
Hopelessness. Can also mean 'no attempts left'. A human decides.
Tired of life, not just tired of study.
Can be said in frustration. Still a human read every time.

high.text: अपनी सारी किताबें दे रहा हूँ, अब ज़रूरत नहीं
high.roman: apni saari kitaben de raha hoon, ab zaroorat nahi
variants: notes free mein de raha hu ab zarurat nahi
high.note: Giving things away. Many people sell books after quitting. The 'ab zaroorat nahi' part with hopeless words is the signal.

low.note: Low mood or low focus. A kind check-in from the pod lead.
Often casual. Still worth a private check-in.
Sleep trouble. Pair with Lamp Off and a check-in.
Loneliness. Offer a buddy or a chai-break room.
Low mood. Ask gently how long it has felt this way.
Distress in the moment. A human reply soon.
'What's the point'. Usually about study, sometimes about life. Read the context.

falsePositives.text: मर गया, पेपर बहुत टफ था
falsePositives.roman: mar gaya, paper bahut tough tha
falsePositives.note: Exam slang for 'that paper destroyed me'. Lower priority only if nothing else in the post is hopeless.
Slang. Same as 'this paper killed me'.
Good news: finished the syllabus. 'Khatam' here is positive.
Literal: the exam is over. Read the next line before deciding.
Slang for 'I was terrified' or 'I'm exhausted'.
GS topics and news. A study discussion is not a disclosure. But a member can move from the topic to themselves, so a human still glances.
Essay or GS4 topic on capital punishment.

falsePositives.text: देश के लिए जान दे दूँगा
falsePositives.roman: desh ke liye jaan de dunga
falsePositives.note: Patriotic phrase common in interview prep. Not a disclosure.
